title: KMPLIFY serverless app manifest (kmplify.app/v1)
description: What a serverless app is, what it may use and what it costs. The marketplace text, icon and screenshots are NOT part of this document: editing a description must never change what executes.

version.description: Semantic version, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release.

lane.description: function = a WebAssembly module (wasm32-wasip1 command), runs on every node. container = an OCI image pinned by digest, runs only on nodes with a gVisor or microVM runtime.

path.description: Path to the .wasm file, relative to the manifest.

sha256.description: Filled in by `kmplify app sign`; if present it must match the file.

image.description: repository@sha256:digest. A tag is not accepted: the signature must name exact bytes.

requirements.description: What a person's own computer needs to use the app, and what the app downloads. Shown on the marketplace and compared with the device ('fits this device'). `resources` is what the sandbox is given; this is what the computer must have.

gpu.description: GPU vendors the app works with. Left out: no GPU needed.

min_disk_mb.description: At least what `contents` adds up to.

contents.description: What the app brings or fetches: models, datasets, libraries, modules. Their sizes add up to the download size people see.

fetched.description: bundled (part of the artifact, the default) or on_first_run.

isolation.description: The weakest sandbox this app may run in. Third-party containers never run below gvisor.

allow.description: host:port the app may open connections to. Everything else is dropped; private, link-local and metadata addresses are always dropped.

permissions.description: Platform services the runtime may hand the app, each scoped to this app's own namespace.

platforms.description: Where people can use the app. Left out: desktop and web. The marketplace only offers the app for the devices named here.

data_class.description: What the app processes. Drives placement: `document` only runs on nodes whose operator accepted the provider terms.

entrypoint.description: Containers only: where the app listens. Reached through the gateway relay, never a public port.

pricing.description: Same models as every marketplace listing. The platform fee is the marketplace's own.
